criteria.criterion: Selection maps changed source, test, support, and global inputs to the expected shard set.

Selection keeps both sides of renames and deletions, reports unmatched Python tests, returns an explicit empty selection, fails unresolved refs, and emits selector JSON for targeted or all-shard runs.
Manifest loading accepts only `advisory`, `ratchet`, or `strict`, emits the pinned timeout values into each archive config, and no duplicate repository mutmut mapping remains.

Advisory returns success for survived, `no tests`, and timeout mutation-quality findings while returning failure for missing, zero-mutant, incomplete, or unrecognized evidence and configuration or execution errors.
Ratchet preserves unchanged legacy survivors and `no tests` and reports newly introduced `no tests` without blocking.

Ratchet blocks killed regressions, missing killed mutants, new survivors, timeouts, and incomplete statuses; added or edited functions require killed mutants or individually reviewed equivalent fingerprints except that `no tests` is report-only.
Strict requires every mutant to be killed or individually fingerprinted and blocks every `no tests`, timeout, incomplete status, and zero-mutant run.
Execution uses fresh archives, restores no verdict cache, pins runtime and concurrency, runs clean-test preflight, generates archive-local config, and always writes structured evidence.

Workflows use selector-derived per-shard matrix jobs with a 30-minute limit each, exact Gerrit patchset checkout, `vote.needs`, push/PR parity, weekly/manual all-shard selection, cancellation, and always-published artifacts.
